dct_title_s: Geomorphic map of California and Nevada with portions of Oregon and Idaho : showing the diastrophic character of the relief, the steep descent from the sub-continental shelf to the floor of the Pacific, and the more important known faults
dct_description_sm: [prepared by the] California State Earthquake Investigation Commission ; Authorities for the position of faults: I.C. Russell [et al.]
Relief shown by shading and bathymetric isolines.
Shows railways, towns, counties and drainage.
This issue shows physiographic provinces and faults.
